title: Procedural 2D Split And Vector Export
description: Split procedural into parallel 2d and 3d packages, add full 2D vector-graphics flow kernel/module, render 2D procedural preview on infinite canvas, keep 3D on infinite world, add SVG PDF PNG exporters.
summary:
Fixed 2D procedural preview end-to-end. Root causes: (1) default fixture synapses used wrong port names (`drawing` instead of `draw.drawing` on outputs), breaking eval wiring; (2) flow eval runs in a worker WASM instance while preview tried `render_drawing_scene` on main-thread WASM with empty draw kernel; (3) framework did not pass `previewMeshes` from worker tessellation to the 2D play controller.

Changes: corrected fixture synapses; extended flow worker `tessellatePreviews` to call `render_drawing_scene` for `drawing-*` handles and recognize `draw.drawing` schema; merged worker scenes into preview items in procedural-2d-play (mirroring 3D mesh path); wired framework `onEvalOutputs` to pass previewMeshes; preview prefers cached `item.scene`, with zoom-at-cursor, middle-mouse pan, and marquee selection; fixed export payload parsing and PNG export from cached scenes.
